game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the innkeeper must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against ice wolves.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against ice wolves. Each round, ice wolves strike the ice mill, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ice mill from ice wolves in Sled Run: keep the spells meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: spells drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Sled Run.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while spells > 0.
